issues.title: Insufficient text contrast
issues.description: The intermediate activity item text and icon have low contrast against the dark background.
issues.evidence: The 'Anomaly detected -> insight agent queued' row is difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Increase foreground luminance for muted timeline events in dark mode.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: system-variant body hardcodes text-neutral-500 (12px mono) = 5.44:1 on dark panel — weak at phone scale; stepped up to text-neutral-600 (7.36:1).

issues.title: Low contrast text
issues.description: Secondary activity entry text lacks sufficient contrast against the dark theme background.
issues.evidence: The 'Export queued -> batch #4471' item is barely readable against the background.
issues.suggestion: Increase opacity or lighten the muted text token in dark mode.
issues.triageNote: Same root cause as pair-061 (independent corroboration): neutral-500 system body on near-black bg; text-neutral-600 raises it to 7.92:1.

issues.title: Low contrast status text
issues.description: Initial event text is excessively faint, reducing legibility.
issues.evidence: Faint text on 'Session started — 44.1 kHz · mono · auto-transcribe on'.
issues.suggestion: Increase font opacity or use a darker neutral token.
issues.triageNote: Real defect, objectively fails WCAG AA: neutral-500 on white card = 3.59:1; text-neutral-600 (5.33:1) fixes light theme too via the inverting neutral scale.
